title: MQTT listener OCSP peer verification can be silently omitted
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server allows TLS and OCSP peer verification to be configured separately for the MQTT listener.

### Problem Description

MQTT OCSP setup consulted the top-level TLS settings instead of the listener-specific settings. A deployment that enabled OCSP peer verification specifically for MQTT could therefore accept client certificates without the configured revocation check. Normal certificate-chain validation does not substitute for this missing revocation check.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.14.9 and v2.15.2. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-8xmc-886f-g496>
